title: Serve the public site's photos at the slot's width instead of the 1600px original

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02 crawl (image weight per route at 1280x900): / 1734KB, /for 2653KB, /features 1645KB, /events/drafts 693KB of images

detail: The brand photos are 1600px JPEGs of 250 to 430KB each and the site pages rendered them with a raw , so every chapter photo, path door, feature job photo and story card downloaded the full original into a 400 to 500px slot. Fix: photoImg() in shared/parts.tsx builds src, srcSet and sizes from next/image's getImageProps (the optimizer already serves the wordmark), ChapPhoto and the ten raw photo imgs on /, /features, /stories and the Discover chapters use it, and the footer wordmark gets sizes="176px" so next/image stops choosing its 1920px rendition on every page. The kit keeps sizing the element. Measured after at 1280: /features 1645KB -> 523KB; / 1734KB -> 1407KB (each chapter photo 25KB instead of 250KB; the rest of / is the hero's two broll backgrounds and the wordmark mask, set in CSS, which a srcset cannot reach). Fixed 2026-11-02; browser check on / and /features at 1280: the chapter photos load as 640px AVIF/WebP renditions.
